title: xmlgenerator YAML configuration
description: JSON Schema for xmlgenerator YAML configuration files.

specific.description: Per-source-schema settings. Keys are source XSD filename patterns or regular expressions; the first matching entry is used.

variables.description: Reusable placeholder expressions available through global('name') and local('name').

global.description: Values evaluated once per process on first access.

local.description: Values evaluated once per generated document.

globalGeneratorConfig.description: Settings applied to all schemas unless overridden by a matching entry in specific.

source_filename.description: Regular expression used to extract a value from the source XSD filename. It should contain the named group (?P<extracted>...).

output_filename.description: Generated XML filename template. Placeholders such as {{ source_extracted }} and {{ uuid }} are allowed.

probability.description: Probability of adding optional elements and attributes.

min_length.description: Lower bound for generated string length.

max_length.description: Upper bound for generated string length.

min_inclusive.description: Lower bound for generated numeric values.

max_inclusive.description: Upper bound for generated numeric values.

valueOverride.description: Generated value overrides. Keys are tag or attribute names, or regular expressions. Values are strings with optional placeholders; null resets an inherited override.
